request_text: Capture June 12 public meeting record and later AAR/IP as candidate evidence only
minimum_packet_contents: FEMA preliminary findings, public meeting materials, final AAR/IP or equivalent evaluation product
acceptance_test: meeting materials or AAR/IP captured with date, source URL or custodian, hash, scope, and all unresolved deficiencies/ARCAs/open issues preserved

request_text: Request ANS demonstration packet and CAP/message artifacts
minimum_packet_contents: ANS/siren/IPAWS/EAS/WEA demonstration logs, activation times, delivery statistics, failure logs, language-access evidence
acceptance_test: message text, polygons/areas, timestamps, delivery/activation evidence, failures, and corrective actions are linked and hashed

request_text: Request timeline export and decision logs
minimum_packet_contents: plant classification, dose assessment, PAR/PAD decision timeline, state/local protective-action decision record
acceptance_test: timeline joins declaration, dose projection, PAR, PAD, public message, and responsible authority; disagreements retained

minimum_packet_contents: controller/evaluator logs, participant rosters, objective coverage matrix, jurisdiction facility activation evidence
acceptance_test: every claimed participating ORO/facility has dated participation evidence and evaluator notes or explicit not-observed flag

minimum_packet_contents: access and functional needs transportation call-downs, route support, pickup/dropoff/reception-center accessibility logs
acceptance_test: sample or anonymized call-down and transport evidence with gaps and no-show/failed-route records retained

request_text: Request EOC/EOF/JIC activation and JIC message packet
minimum_packet_contents: EOC/EOF/JIC activation logs, shift handoff, message approval chain, rumor-control board, communication outage/degraded mode records
acceptance_test: activation and handoff records align to messages and decisions; degraded modes recorded

request_text: Request CRC exercise logs and bottleneck notes
minimum_packet_contents: CRC/reception center throughput, monitoring/decon logs, staffing, equipment, contamination-control and privacy/language-access records
acceptance_test: throughput and monitoring/decon records show timestamps, staffing, equipment status, and unresolved constraints

minimum_packet_contents: EMS/hospital contaminated-patient transport, ED isolation/decon, radiation consultation, transfer network records
acceptance_test: dated exercise logs include patient handoff, contamination control, dose/radiological consultation, and corrective actions

request_text: Request field monitoring and sampling custody packet
minimum_packet_contents: field team deployment, instruments, calibration, sampling custody, lab transfer, results reporting timeline
acceptance_test: instrument/calibration IDs, sample custody, deployment times, lab handoff, and data-quality flags recorded

request_text: Request current issue ledger and retest evidence
minimum_packet_contents: open/closed ARCA/deficiency/issue ledger, previous issue closure evidence, retest schedule and owner
acceptance_test: each issue has owner, severity, closure evidence or open status; no closure without retest where required
